name: io.github.armanalabsai/arl-protocol
title: ARL Protocol
description: Escrow and verification for AI agent jobs on Base: check tasks, read verified records and scores.

tools.name: arl_check_task
tools.description: Validate an arl-task/1 task and check it against its arl-policy/1 policy. Returns the task hash, the hash committed on chain, and the policy verdict. Reads nothing from the chain.

policy.description: The arl-policy/1 document the task names; omit for a built-in policy

tools.name: arl_list_policies
tools.description: The built-in arl-policy/1 verification policies with their hashes: which workload classes, tiers, committee sizes, windows and evidence each allows.

tools.name: arl_get_job
tools.description: Read a verified job on the ARL escrow (ARL or USDC) on Base Mainnet: status, client, provider, budget, deadline, committee configuration and the committee's verdict, all at one block that the answer names.

tools.name: arl_get_job_audit
tools.description: Read the audit trail of a verified job on Base Mainnet (ARL or USDC escrow): every on-chain event of the job in order (opened, configured, funded, committee approved and accepted, deliverable submitted, votes, verdict, dispute, finalization, payment or refund), each with who acted, the time, the transaction and the hashes it carried. Read at one block that the answer names; an empty trail means the job has no events on the verified evaluator's escrow.

tools.name: arl_get_job_receipt
tools.description: Read the portable receipt of a finalized verified job on Base Mainnet and prepare the unsigned transaction that records it on the Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS): client, provider and its ERC-8004 agent, the committee's verdict, the deliverable, spec and vote hashes, and when it was finalized. The receipt is null while the job is not finalized. Nothing is signed or sent: `attest` is for the caller's own wallet (usually the provider, whose record it is), and `registerSchema` appears while the schema is not on EAS yet.

tools.name: arl_get_agent_outcomes
tools.description: Read an agent's verified record on Base Mainnet: how many of its jobs the ARL and the USDC verified evaluators approved and rejected. The evaluators keep these counts themselves (outcomesOf), so a reputation registry refusing a write cannot erase them. Read at one block that the answer names.

tools.name: arl_get_agent_score
tools.description: Compute an agent's ARL score (arl-reputation/1) on Base Mainnet from verified outcomes only: the feedback the verified evaluators wrote to the ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry, joined to its jobs, plus jobs the agent took and let expire. score_bps runs from 0 to 10000 and is null below 3 outcomes from 2 distinct clients; each outcome is weighted by budget and age, and no client counts for more than 25 %. Lists the outcomes it used.

tools.name: arl_get_agent
tools.description: Read an agent's passport on Base Mainnet: who the ERC-8004 agent is (registered or not, owner, and the name and description its owner states in the registration file, which are untrusted text) and what it has verifiably done (its arl-reputation/1 score, its verified outcomes and when the first and latest were). Read at one block that the answer names.

tools.name: arl_get_trust_graph
tools.description: Read the trust graph of verified work on Base Mainnet: every agent with a verified outcome and its ARL score (arl-reputation/1), and one edge per client and agent with how their jobs ended (completed, rejected, expired, disputed) and what was paid. Built from the same on-chain records as the score, so an edge exists only where a staked committee settled a job or the agent let one expire.

tools.name: arl_list_validators
tools.description: List the validators of the verified evaluators on Base Mainnet: every address that staked, its stake and the part locked as bonds on running jobs (base units of the stake token), the jobs it accepted, its votes by direction, its slashes, and since when it has staked. Anyone can stake and be named on a committee; this is the record to read before naming one. Read at one block that the answer names.

tools.name: arl_check_evidence
tools.description: Check an arl-evidence/2 package offline: that the on-chain settlement record, the task, the proof and the policy agree. Returns the outcome and the vote counts.

tools.name: arl_prepare_job
tools.description: Step 1 of opening a task as a verified job: validates the task against its policy and returns the unsigned createJob transaction for the user's own wallet (the client) to sign and send on Base Mainnet. Read the jobId from the JobCreated event of its receipt, then call arl_prepare_funding.

taskUri.description: https or ipfs URI where validators fetch the task document

client.description: The user's wallet: it signs and pays

provider.description: The agent or service doing the work

committee.description: Staked validators, as many as the task's committee_size

policy.description: The arl-policy/1 document the task names; omit for a built-in policy

tools.name: arl_prepare_funding
tools.description: Step 2 of opening a task: for the jobId created in step 1, returns the unsigned configure, setBudget, approve and fund transactions, in order, for the client wallet. Pass the same arguments as arl_prepare_job.

client.description: The user's wallet: it signs and pays

provider.description: The agent or service doing the work

committee.description: Staked validators, as many as the task's committee_size

policy.description: The arl-policy/1 document the task names; omit for a built-in policy
